name: Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84 2012 (Data for Calendar Year 2011)
description:
This dataset contains energy and water use disclosures filed by New York City buildings under Local Law 84 for calendar year 2011. Each row represents one building and includes identifying and location details (address, borough, community board, council district, census tract, latitude/longitude), physical characteristics (floor area, year built, facility type), and reported utility consumption. Energy fields cover electricity, natural gas, district steam, several grades of fuel oil, and diesel, along with site and source energy totals, ENERGY STAR ratings, greenhouse gas emissions, and renewable or green power figures. Water fields cover indoor, outdoor, and other water use. Many columns capture space-use details specific to building categories such as offices, multifamily housing, hotels, hospitals, schools, retail, parking, warehouses, and data centers, plus data-quality flags and alerts.
